WPSS No.1205 of 2026
Hon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Jai Krishna Pandey, learned Counsel for 
petitioner.
2. Mr. Ananya Thapliyal, learned Counsel for 
respondents-UPCL.
3. Petitioner was working with respondent￾Department on the post of Office Assistant Grade-III, 
and according to him, he was entitled to be promoted 
from the date, persons junior to him were given 
promotion. Later on, vide order dated 09.10.2025, 
petitioner was also given promotion by the 
respondent-Department to the post of Office Assistant 
Grade-II but from the date of joining. The petitioner is 
before this Court claiming that he should be given 
promotion from the date of his entitlement i.e. the 
date on which persons junior to him were promoted.
4. Learned Counsel for respondents prays for and is 
granted four weeks’ time to file counter affidavit.
5. List on 29.06.2026 showing the name of Mr. 
Ananya Thapliyal as counsel for respondents. 
(Pankaj Purohit, J.)
